about: Ad rules v1 for the site's home feed (www.facebook.com, Comet GraphQL), proposed in M2b from the owner's recordings of 2026-10-02 (docs/findings/payloads.md section 5). Evaluated by extension/src/lib/adRules.ts. A feed edge is removed only when signals of at least minFamilies different families match: signals of one family state the same fact, so one decoy field can never cause a removal. Field names on this site are obfuscated and may rotate (th_dat_spo stands for sponsored data, sposnsor_new_distac_action is misspelled at the source); every family therefore also has a test on a type name, which names the schema type rather than the field.

signals.why: The story's sponsored-data object (type SponsoredData, carries ad_id and client_token). Null on every organic story recorded.
Edge-level number set only on sponsored edges (null on every organic edge recorded). It sits outside the story node, written by the feed's ranking layer, not by the story.
The header's metadata renders the Sponsored label through this strategy; organic stories carry audience, timestamp or attribution strategies instead.
The attachment is rendered with the ad style (4 of 5 recorded ads; the fifth was a video ad with the normal video style).

suggestionSignals.why: A Follow button in the story title: the viewer does not follow the author, so the story was recommended.
Header metadata strategy for a recommendation label.
A persistent bumper that explains why the story is shown.
A showcase unit of short videos (Reels) instead of a story.
